notes: League is 'Liga Portugal Betclic' (season 7 Aug 2026 - 16 May 2027). Domestic rights are still sold club by club in 2026-27 (centralised sale due from 2027-28 or 2028-29, depending on the source). Sport TV shows all matches except Benfica home games (BTV) and Moreirense home games (TVI / V+). International rights for 2026-27 and 2027-28 are distributed by Sportfive on behalf of Sport TV. Gaps: no 2026-27 holder was found for the UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand or Scandinavia. FITE/TrillerTV held those markets only up to 2025-26, and no renewal was found, so they are left out. Also not found: Canada, France, MENA, Africa (incl. Angola/Mozambique) and Spanish-speaking Latin America. RTP Internacional previously showed one match per round abroad (e.g. Spain), but no 2026-27 confirmation was found. Belgium and Japan come from DAZN multi-territory deal reports (Sportfive deal) only. A web search quota limit stopped further territory research.

broadcasters.note: Sport TV (Sport TV 1/2 etc., plus the Sport TV Multiscreen app for subscribers) shows every match except two clubs' home games. Benfica home games are exclusive to the club's pay channel BTV under a NOS deal covering 2026-27 and 2027-28. Moreirense home games (deal Aug 2025 - Jun 2028) air on free-to-air TVI, or on V+ depending on the schedule. Flashscore calls these free, but V+ is a cable/IPTV channel that needs a pay-TV package (no premium sports subscription). The 2026-27 round 1 listing (Sport TV 1/2, BTV, TVI) confirms this setup.

DAZN has a non-exclusive deal for three matches per matchday in 2026-27 and 2027-28, with English commentary, via Sportfive. Since August 2026 Sport TV also sells an app subscription to individual residents of Spain (EUR 34.99/month) covering Liga Portugal Betclic and Liga 2 content. RTP Internacional showed the league in Spain in previous seasons.

Exclusive. DAZN Italia renewed through 2027-28 and shows selected matches each round (mainly Porto, Benfica and Sporting games; up to three per round under the Sportfive multi-territory deal), plus highlights.
